gaps.after: The loser labels the kind with the vague 'Periodically' and shows a bare '7' dropdown with no unit and no outcome; the winner reads 'After Completion / Every [7] days', adds an Ends row, and a muted ~13px 'Done today? Next: Sun, Oct 23' line that states what will happen
gaps.weekly: The loser uses seven bare ~16px checkboxes over ambiguous single letters (S M T W T F S, two S and two T) and shows no next date; the winner uses ~40x34px filled pill chips with three-letter labels, the selected day in solid blue (#4A90F0-ish) with white text, plus a 'Next: Fri, Oct 6' preview
gaps.monthly: The loser's disabled 'On day' option shows a nonsensical 'Last' value and there is no next-occurrence line, so it never confirms which date results; the winner dims a concrete '29th' and adds 'Next: Fri, Oct 27' under an Ends row
gaps.kinds: The loser's kind menu is a plain popup that overflows the picker and is clipped at the bottom edge, cutting 'Periodically' in half, with bare option names and no preview; the winner lists every kind inline with a right-aligned muted preview (Every day, Fridays, The 29th, Sep 29, Every 2 weeks, 1 week) and separates After Completion with a hairline divider
gaps.phone: The loser truncates the row label to 'R...' next to the repeat icon, a visible layout bug that leaves the only row unlabelled and exposes no controls; the winner gives a full panel with a ~20px 'Repeat' label, After Completion menu, a ~44px-tall '4' stepper field, Ends row, next-date line and a Stop Repeating action

why: The winners consistently state the outcome (Next: date, per-kind previews) and avoid the loser's clipping, truncation and ambiguous single-letter checkboxes
